_comment: Was WARD, which is a different keyword entirely — ward is 'pay {r} to prevent', a cost the defender may decline, not a flat shield. 'Prevent the next N damage' is a one-shot replacement (CR 6.4). The cost was also invented: the card says '{r}, discard this', not pay 1 life and destroy it. The Lightning Flow token is conditional on damage actually being prevented ('if you prevent damage this way'), which is not modelled — the token is created unconditionally, which is more generous than printed.
